boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, photo-documentable destinations on the campus-adjacent St. Mary Street and Mount Assisi corridors in Loretto.

cards.title: Biddle's Brewing Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Walk the St. Mary Street corridor to photograph the coffeehouse storefront at 268 St. Mary Street; the university identifies coffee, lattes, and bakery items.
cards.short_summary: A named coffeehouse and bakery on Loretto’s main nearby corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University identifies Biddle's Brewing Coffeehouse at 268 St. Mary Street and notes that it serves coffee, lattes, and bakery items.
cards.access_notes: Commercial venue; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Smithmyer's Superette
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Use the St. Mary Street walk for a grocery stop at 163 St. Mary Street; the university describes an in-store meat department and bakery.
cards.short_summary: A documented family-operated grocery destination near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists Smithmyer's Superette in Loretto and describes it as family owned and operated with an in-store meat department and bakery.
cards.access_notes: Commercial venue; confirm current store access and offerings directly before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel
cards.title: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Pause along St. Mary Street to photograph the Basilica exterior and pair it with the nearby Gallitzin memorial sites documented by the regional visitor bureau.
cards.short_summary: A named religious landmark anchoring the Loretto corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown identifies the Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies as located between the Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.source_title: The Shrine Of Our Lady Of The Alleghenies | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Religious site; observe posted visitor guidance and service-related access.

cards.entity_name: The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies
cards.title: The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Make this a short St. Mary Street landmark stop: the visitor bureau places the shrine between the Basilica and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.short_summary: A named shrine connecting three historic Loretto destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies at 321 Saint Mary's Street, between the Basilica and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.source_title: The Shrine Of Our Lady Of The Alleghenies | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Outdoor religious landmark; respect the site and any posted access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb
cards.title: Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Plan a seasonal St. Mary Street stop at the tomb beside the Basilica; the regional visitor bureau says this underground crypt is open April through October.
cards.short_summary: A named crypt beside the Basilica with a published seasonal window.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb at 321 Saint Mary's Street, adjacent to the Basilica, and states it is open April through October.
cards.source_title: Servant Of God Demetrius Gallitzin’s Tomb | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: The published access period is April through October; verify conditions before making a special trip.

cards.title: Prince Gallitzin Chapel House
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: At 357 St. Mary Street, arrange a tour appointment to see the chapel house’s sanctuary, artifacts, and the residential area once occupied by Gallitzin.
cards.short_summary: A named historic chapel house with appointment-based tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists Prince Gallitzin Chapel House at 357 Saint Mary's Street, describes its sanctuary and artifacts, and says tours are available by appointment.
cards.source_title: Prince Gallitzin Chapel House | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Tours are available by appointment, according to the listed visitor information.

cards.title: Captain Michael McGuire Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: Metz Road corridor beside campus, Loretto
cards.notes: Follow Metz Road beside campus to this named community park; it was created as a multi-use space for health, fitness, and Loretto heritage.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent public park with recreation and heritage purposes.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University reports that Captain Michael McGuire Memorial Park is on Metz Road adjacent to campus and describes it as a multi-use community facility.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor community park; use public paths and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Mount Assisi Sunken Gardens
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Take the Saint Francis Drive spur to the gardens at Mount Assisi and walk the landscaped grounds; the Friars say the shrines are open sunrise to sunset daily.
cards.short_summary: A named garden destination on the Mount Assisi section of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars list the Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi at 105 Saint Francis Drive and state that the shrines are open to the public from sunrise to sunset seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public sunrise to sunset seven days a week; observe site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima
cards.title: Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Mount Assisi
cards.notes: Use the Mount Assisi garden path to locate this named shrine; its official page places it in the Sunken Gardens and lists sunrise-to-sunset access.
cards.short_summary: A named shrine within the documented Mount Assisi garden grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars state that the Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima is located in Mount Assisi's Sunken Gardens at 105 Saint Francis Drive and is open sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: The shrine is listed as open sunrise to sunset; observe religious-site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Stations of the Cross at Mount Assisi
cards.title: Stations of the Cross at Mount Assisi
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Mount Assisi
cards.notes: Walk the named Stations along the Mount Assisi grounds rather than entering restricted areas; the Friars identify them as lining the garden walkway.
cards.short_summary: A documented outdoor devotional route within the Mount Assisi grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars' tourism brochure states that the Stations of the Cross line the walkway at the Shrines and Sunken Gardens, which are open free of charge from sunrise to sunset daily.
cards.source_title: The Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi Tourism Brochure
cards.access_notes: The brochure states the grounds are open free of charge from sunrise to sunset, seven days a week.
